role.zh: BIM 工程師 / 建築助理

desc.en: Responsible for 3D BIM modeling, parametric family creation, and interdisciplinary clash detection using Autodesk Revit.
desc.zh: 負責使用 Revit 進行 3D BIM 模型建置、元件庫繪製，以及跨專業衝突檢核與協調。

company: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology (NTUST)

desc.en: Focused on architectural design, digital modeling, and building technology. Earned Autodesk Certified User: Revit Architecture certification.
desc.zh: 專攻建築設計、數位建模與建築技術，並於在學期間考取 Autodesk Certified User: Revit Architecture 原廠認證。
